patthana15.46:1.1: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana15.46:2.1: Cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi. (Abyākatamūlaṃ tīṇiyeva paccayavasena.)
